Since the rate of drug entry into the cell and its subsequent anti-cancer function is related to its lipophilic nature, for the compounds I and II, the amount of lipophilicity (using partition coefficients) was determined by “shake-flask” method [30]. A sufficient quantity of complex I and complex II was solubilized in a water/octanol mixture (10 mL, 1: 1 v/v) and agitated at ambient temperature for a duration of 12 h. After the complete separation of the two phases, the UV–Vis spectrum of both the water and octanol phases were recorded. Using the determination of concentrations in both phases and placing them in Eq. (1), the partition coefficient (log P) values for two complexes were calculated.
